content.short: Hipo Finance is a TON liquid staking protocol where users stake any amount of TON and receive staking rewards.
content.description: Hipo Finance is a liquid staking protocol for TON. Users can stake any amount of Toncoin, keep liquidity through the protocol design, and earn staking rewards, making it a DeFi option for users who want yield without running validator infrastructure. Hipo is The #1 Most Profitable Liquid Staking on TON, allowing you to stake any amount of TON and earn rewards beyond staking rewards!. Hipo Finance belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface.
